retryRun.window.missing: Choose when payments open and when they close. Both are needed before the retry can be raised.
retryRun.window.past: Payments must open later than now. Choose a later time for them to open.
retryRun.window.order: Payments must close after they open. Choose a later time for them to close.
retryRun.walletNote: Your wallet opens to show you these people and their total. Nothing is raised until you confirm there.
retryRun.done: The retry was raised. It waits for the approvals it needs.
retryRun.done.counted: The retry was raised. It has {approvals} of the {needed} approvals it needs.
retryRun.why.seat: Your account could not act for this company on this device, so nothing was raised.
retryRun.why.not-a-run: Your wallet could not read a retry from what this page named, so nothing was raised.
retryRun.why.window: The payment window this page gave was not one your wallet could use, or the run can still pay these people, so nothing was raised.
retryRun.why.not-as-shown: The retry your wallet built is not the one this page showed, so nothing was raised.
retryRun.why.not-raised: The retry was not raised, and nothing was sent to the network.
retryRun.why.may-be-sent: Your wallet handed the retry on, and did not confirm it went. Do not raise it again: look for it on this run and on the Proposals page.
retryRun.why.other: Your wallet stopped for a reason this page does not know, so nothing was raised.
